trigger: The first real-checkpoint loader invocation failed before model evaluation or any parameter update because the mathematically identity pre-GELU FHT basis/inverse round trip was not bitwise identical in FP32.

amendment.endpoint_identity_check: Evaluate the all-zero frame and the same checkpoint with the frame disabled on the separate preflight safety tokens; require absolute CE difference at most 1e-6 before any update.
amendment.frozen_state_bitwise_requirement: unchanged; every non-coordinate state tensor must remain bitwise identical across preflight updates
amendment.rationale: The discrepancy is a deterministic normalized-FHT floating-point round trip at about 1.54e-7 relative Frobenius error, not a learned or validation-selected perturbation. Replacing it with a branch at zero would erase the required coordinate gradient, while residualizing the operator would change the preregistered chart away from zero. A strict roundoff bound plus a complete-model CE identity comparison preserves the intended test.

unchanged: all optimization tokens, seeds, updates, learning rate, and optimizer fields
all evaluation windows, ablations, thresholds, and decision rules
all structure dimensions and fixed bases
the 20 percent MFU and CE safety gates
